gripOrHq.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

gripOrHq.title: Promises, Promises
gripOrHq.rulesText: The next time you access an agenda this turn, score 1 additional agenda point.

heapOrArchives.title: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Networking
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [9]. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

rig.title: Psychic Friend
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break code gate subroutine. [2]: +1 strength until end of turn

rig.title: R&D-Protocol Files
rig.rulesText: A: Make a run on R&D, but instead of accessing cards, look at the top five cards of R&D.

rig.title: R&D Mole
rig.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from R&D. Use this ability only when accessing cards from R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: HQ Mole
rig.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from HQ. Use this ability only when accessing cards from HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Systematic Layoffs
root.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.
